analysis.evidence: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ identifies the groups just listed as the families of Noah’s sons. The verse then traces the nations of the earth to these families.
analysis.morphology: Feminine plural construct of a common noun. The following phrase בְּנֵי נֹחַ specifies whose families they are.
